name: twinsanityevolved
description: Windows dependency manifest (CMakePresets.json windows-clang-cl-* through cmake/windows-clang-cl.toolchain.cmake; tools/ci/release_dist.ps1): the two runtime libraries the binary links -- the same two the engine's manifest names; LGPL FFmpeg features only (avcodec + swscale) -- plus the Khronos GL registry headers the engine's Windows GL loader includes (opengl-registry). builtin-baseline = the vcpkg commit the port versions are resolved against (github.com/microsoft/vcpkg master HEAD on 2026-10-17, `git ls-remote https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg HEAD`; the VCPKG_ROOT checkout must contain it -- docs/WINDOWS.md section 2). KEEP IDENTICAL to engine/vcpkg.json (the same baseline): the engine's ExternalProject shares this manifest's installed tree (CMakeLists.txt,). macOS and Linux build SDL2/FFmpeg statically from the engine's recipes (tools/ci/release_dist.sh).
